messages:
morgan: quick heads-up — found a broken anchor on kb/routing/how-routing-works.md. The in-page link to 'policy overview' goes to `#routing-policies` which 404s. Saw this from a support ticket. @jia any chance you can claim and fix? :eyes:

- docs-bot: link-checker found 1 broken anchor in `kb/routing/how-routing-works.md` (line ~213)

- jia: I'll take it. prob a small anchor rename from recent edits. I'll open a tiny PR with the fix.

- benji: thx @jia — can you also add a one-liner in the changelog that this was an anchor rename so we can track? no rush.

- jia: yep. plan:
  1) update anchor in md to `#policy-overview`
  2) add redirect snippet at top if needed
  3) changelog entry

- jia:

```md
- rename anchor from `#routing-policies` to `#policy-overview`
+ rename anchor to `#policy-overview` (fixes broken support link)
```

- morgan: thanks. PR ping when ready — looks safe to merge after one reviewer.

- elaine: I can review later today, ping me when PR is up.

- jia: PR opened — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/742 (small 1-line change + changelog)

- oncall: was this causing any incident? just checking. :thinking_face:

- morgan: no major outage. Support ticket showed incorrect jump to bottom of page. Not blocking.

- elaine: reviewed, left one tiny nit about wording in changelog.

- jia: addressed nit, pushed. requesting review from @elaine for final ok.

- elaine: LGTM :thumbsup: merging now.

- docs-bot: deploy-preview updated: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/742 — anchor works now.

- morgan: awesome, thanks everyone — closing this thread.
